data.long_meaning: One who is constantly in search of knowledge and guidance from Allah. The name Masheedi is derived from the Arabic word ‘masaha’ which means ‘to seek’ or ‘to ask’. This name is a reminder of the importance of seeking knowledge and guidance from Allah and striving to live a righteous and obedient life. The name Masheedi carries the meaning “Seeker of knowledge or guidance” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Masheedi usually hope their child will grow to embody seeker of knowledge or guidance and live with faith, good character and purpose.
